search_window.basis: Conservative overlap from the most recent heartbeat independently fetched and verified in this execution (10:42:40 PST); an intervening 11:45 check could not be independently located using available repository file listing actions. Retrieval queries use two-day recency to accommodate indexing lag, while eligibility requires a new substantive disruption in the observation window.

coverage_notes.observation: No newly verified U.S. event in any of the four specified disruption classes was found in the bounded queries. Search hits were predominantly dated months or a year earlier, from outside the United States, or routine resource/schedule notices. A November 1, 2026 Ohio mobile-pantry schedule did not identify any emergency cancellation. Search-result crawl dates were not treated as event dates.

coverage_notes.limitations: Web searches returned usable coverage but were heavily weighted toward older results and historical 2025 SNAP interruptions. No fresh official notice confirming one of the narrow disruption classes was located. Cannot establish absence of nationwide incidents; supplementary recall only. Immediate predecessor 11:45 ledger file was not independently discovered with available connector directory operations.
